verdict.rationale: PagerDuty docs claim general Slack-based incident management ('Manage incidents and coordinate response from Slack') and Slack integration for starting Post-Incident Reviews, implying some chat-native workflow, but there is no explicit description of declaring an incident via a Slack/Teams command, auto-creating a dedicated incident channel, assigning roles, or posting structured updates — and Teams support is not evidenced at all. missing for 10: explicit docs on Slack/Teams slash-command incident declaration, automatic channel creation, role assignment, and Teams-specific chat support.
